features.quote: We do not claim to measure subjective experience, "real" emotions, or model welfare.
features.justification_quote: Over-claiming (e.g. "this measures suffering") would be unscientific and would undermine the eval's credibility for safety work.

features.quote: ModelError is treated as a recoverable per-sample failure (recorded, excluded from metrics) rather than aborting a run
features.justification_quote: keeps a single flaky API call from destroying a multi-hour run
